description: This file implements a class for handling real-time communication with OpenAI's `/v1/realtime` endpoint over WebSockets. It includes methods for constructing the WebSocket URL and managing the asynchronous WebSocket connection, including error handling. The class extends `OpenAIChatCompletion` and interacts with various utility modules for logging, streaming, and SSL context handling.
